versions.changelog:
Initial release: a negotiation/game-theory engine providing computable Nash, Rubinstein, Shapley, and minimax solutions for multi-party negotiation and allocation scenarios.

- Supports calculation of closed-form equilibrium solutions (Nash bargaining, Rubinstein alternating offers, Shapley value, minimax).
- Includes self-testing to verify solution correctness against theoretical values.
- Integrates self-evolution and reliability fallback: automatic checks and meta-evolution workflow.
- Provides practical command-line usage examples for all major solution modes.
- Documents known limitations (e.g., minimax discretization, Shapley value complexity for many players).
